name: Scott's Connecticut Valley Orchards
tagline: Scott's Connecticut Valley Orchards at https://scottsfarms.com/
description: Scott's Connecticut Valley Orchards is a family-run farm in 274 Kelsey Hill Road, CT. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
